description: This file defines the Banner controller class for the Opencart admin panel, handling operations related to banners such as generating task lists, listing banners, generating banner info, and clearing generated files.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class managing banner-related tasks within the Opencart admin panel, including task list generation, banner listing, info generation, and file cleanup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of banner-related tasks for each store and language combination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a list of banners for a given store and language, creating tasks for each banner to generate detailed info.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Creates a JSON file with detailed information about a specific banner, including images.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes previously generated JSON banner files across all stores and languages.
